endToEndSmoke.coverage: setup wizard -> login -> boot sequence -> lead creation -> dedupe -> 40m2 estimate -> QA-gated quote -> PDF generation -> Agent 06 photo section renders -> lead-scoped Ask Beyza -> inventory/AI-usage/suppliers pages render -> calendar/follow-ups/finance pages render -> ICS export route returns a real calendar file -> Agent Network (20 agents) -> full-screen call mode text command -> Beyza Ayarları -> zero console errors across the whole run; plus a second test verifying prefers-reduced-motion disables the AI Core's CSS animations
endToEndSmoke.runNote: Requires a running dev server against a fresh, empty database and the pre-installed Chromium (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers). Not part of `npm run check`, but now also wired into .github/workflows/ci.yml as a separate CI job. Against `next dev` specifically (not a production server), the first hit to each route pays a compile cost — the relevant assertions use generous timeouts (15s) to absorb that; the CI job runs a production build instead, so it isn't affected.
